name: Bob Evans Farms - Sulphur Springs TX Plant
type: Manufacturing plant (refrigerated sides, including Bob Evans Macaroni & Cheese)

fieldNotes.truckGate: Two open driveways off Industrial Dr E (front employee/visitor drive and a west truck drive). Both are open curb cuts with no barrier arm, gate, or pinch-point. Confirmed in Street View (2025-06) — no perimeter fence around the property.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth at either driveway. A covered shelter near the parking lot is a carport/break shelter, not a guard booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate, so no remote check-in implied.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Large open paved yard between Industrial Dr E and the south dock face gives deep approach room (3+ trucks).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide open paved truck yard on the south/west of the building provides ample internal staging.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South-facing dock bank with ~5-6 angled dock bays with trailers backed in, plus additional doors along the building face; ~12 doors estimated. 10-25 band; exact count uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A few trailers parked near the dock apron without tractors; no dedicated striped drop lot. 0-10 band.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial area along I-30 near Sulphur Springs, TX, bordered by farm fields and scattered industrial buildings; classified Rural.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Open paved yard could hold ~15 trailers informally; estimate.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large connected plant building plus an attached/adjacent processing wing — counted as ~2 structures.
